title: Rework model ingest pipeline — introduce CheckpointAdapter and ShardCoordinator
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: Over the last two years various teams added quick adapters to support new checkpoint formats (v1, v2, sharded-v1, fused-quant) and ad-hoc sharding logic was scattered across the model loader, kv-cache priming, and tokenizer startup paths. This has caused fragile upgrade paths, duplicated I/O logic, and inconsistent metrics for cold-start model load times.

Goal: Consolidate weight format handling behind a single CheckpointAdapter interface, centralize shard bookkeeping in a ShardCoordinator, and decouple tokenizer initialization from binary weight ingestion. Deliverables: (1) CheckpointAdapter abstraction with format negotiator and streaming loader; (2) ShardCoordinator service to compute shard placement, validation and reassembly; (3) Tokenizer loader plugin that can be started independently and hot-swapped; (4) migration plan and compatibility shim to support existing on-disk layouts for two release cycles.
acceptance_criteria: All supported checkpoint formats are handled by the CheckpointAdapter API (no format-specific branching in model_loader.cpp)
Sharding logic removed from model runtime paths and exported to a single ShardCoordinator module with unit tests
Tokenizer initialization no longer blocks weight streaming — model process can start with tokenizer ready and weights streamed in parallel
End-to-end cold model load time reduced by >=25% on representative GPU instance in our perf harness
Backward compatibility shim passes migration suite for existing customer checkpoints
Documentation: design doc and migration notes published; at least one internal demo/presentation recorded
comments: 2025-01-09 - Aisha: Created ticket after postmortem review of slowded-2025-01 incident. Initial spike showed duplicated checksum passes and synchronous tokenizer reads that serialized S3 fetches.

2025-01-15 - Liam: Completed spike. Proposed CheckpointAdapter interface (open/stream/read_chunk/metadata) and a streaming checksum validator. Draft PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4867.
2025-01-20 - Design review notes from Priya (PM): prefer an explicit migration toggle to avoid surprise failures for on-prem customers. Add config: 'checkpoint_adapter.legacy_mode'
2025-01-23 - Security review (Carlos): KMS envelope handling must remain unchanged; CheckpointAdapter should accept an optional decrypt callback. Added to acceptance criteria.
2025-01-28 - Eng sync: Decided to implement ShardCoordinator as a library first (no RPC) to keep rollout simple. Will convert to a light RPC later if needed for Dedicated multi-pod restores.
2025-02-01 - QA: Integration tests flake on large-shard reassembly case. Root cause: buffer reallocation in streaming path. Liam pushed fix in PR 4892; rerunning the harness.

2025-02-02 - Aisha: Updated ticket with perf numbers from internal harness (maya-loadbench): baseline cold-start 18.3s -> refactor prototype 12.8s (~30% improvement) when using streaming reads and parallel tokenizer init. Still work to do on memory peak.
Review feedback summary: prefer small, reviewable PRs that replace one caller at a time; add metrics for per-shard read time and tokeniser-init-wait-time
blockers: On-prem customers with pre-quantized fused files require a compatibility shim — need sample checkpoints from two customers for testing
Large-shard reassembly flakes intermittently in CI under heavy I/O load; root cause investigation in progress
